narr: A well-organized thunderstorm complex tracked southward from southwest Indiana down across the Pennyrile region of western Kentucky. A couple of reports of tree damage were received with the strong winds along the leading edge of the complex. As the complex of storms took shape, it persisted long enough over the Owensboro area for significant flash flooding. This morning round of severe thunderstorms was associated with a southwest wind flow of hot and humid air ahead of a cold front that extended from Wisconsin to northwest Missouri.
ev: At least one water rescue was conducted on the southeast side of Owensboro. A road was impassable near the Owensboro airport. A family was rescued from high water at their home just northeast of Masonville. A personal weather station in eastern Daviess County measured around 3.5 inches during the morning, much of which fell in 90 minutes.
